content: Hen jisí bi naihoh quehax sca haibo sanareneni, jaa jisxon honanti, non jahueja Papan jaiquin hihxon non honannon. Bari xabapan rahcotax hoxne jamacax nichi. Doce huishiyahpa maiti maihax.
Tohoyahax baque bihcatsihquish huaohihscai, camicasquimahax hisini.

Hoque sca hen jisí bi naihoh huetsa hahan honanti jaribiscai, capepahhuan sca. Chihiyahpa quesca capepahhuan joshini. Siete mapoyahpa, chonca machanyahpa. Quiquin hapon maiti maihi, mapo tihibi jai jahuen maiti.

Jahuen jina huinquin huinquin hahxon nai behuasxon hicha huishi potaquin main paquenon. Rabe janin huishi janon huetsanco huishi yamascai, jan nai behuasah. Haibaan jahuen baque bihcatsihqui bi jaa bebonbi capepahhuan nichi manati, cainscaiton jahuen baque pihannoxon.

Baquexo cainah bi bebo baque, jatihibi nahuabaan quiquin hapo hihxon jato cahnexonma yono yonoyaxihqui bebo baque pishca. Cainaiton bi bochiquixon Papan bihinihniquin, Papa janin hihnon, janoxon jan yonohi janinbi.
Jahuen baquexo cain sca jaax, haibo jabati, jano tsoa yamahiton cahi nihi naman joneti. Jano jati ta Papan jaa bexojaxonnishqui, mil doscientos sesenta neten jano pimaxon coiranabo.

Naihoh hen jisribiha bi rehtenannanscacani. Papan quiquin yonoti Miguel jahuen hahbe yonotiboya jahuex jaa capepahhuan betan rehtenani. Jahuen hahbe yoshinboyahpahax capepahhuan coshin rehtenani, Miguelninabo betan.
Miguelnin coshi betan capepahhuan senenyamahi. Miguelnin jabamaha bi naihoh jahuenbi catimahi.

Miguelnin potahah main sca jahuen hahbe yoshinbo betan jaa capepahhuan paqueti. Jahuen jane huetsa cahen rono xeni, huetsa jahuen jane cahen diablo, huetsa jahuen jane cahen Satanas, main jihuetaibo rahsi parannica.

Naihoh sca coshin yohuanai hean nincaquin: —Papan ta noque hihti hahxonscaiqui. Jahuen coshi jismaxon ta jahuen jihuetahbo jihuemascanoxihquiqui. Jahuen baque Cristo betan ta jahuen jihuetahbo jihuemascanoxihquiqui. Noquen huetsabo cahenica ta potascaiqui, Papa bebonxon noquen huetsabo cahebahinaxon caheshinahi yoshin.
Noquen carneronen jimin ta jahuen jonibaan jaa yoshin namanjahiqui, Papan joi yohixon rihbi jaa namanjaquin. Mahuanoxon caman ta Papan joi jeneyamacannishqui.

Jaa copi jenimanahue naibon. Jenimanahue naihoh quehabon. Huaohihnahue maibon, hianbon. Mato qui ta tiroma yoshin paquetihqui. Sina sina ta jaiqui. Jaa casticanti nea pishca jaonahiqui honanax ta sinatihqui —hihqui.
Main potahah bochiqui jenquetsahax catima sca jaax, jaa baquexon mama sca benahi cahi, jaa sca rehtecatsihquin.

Jaan rehteyamanon hihxon chiquihhuan pehi rabe hinanscacanquin. Pehiyahpa sca jaax noyacahini cahax Papan jaa bexojaxonai janin cahi. Tiroma yoshiman merayamascanon jano sca coirancanquin. Quimisha bari huinotax huetsa bari pochinicon sca noconon caman piti hinancanquin.
Jaa haibo rehtecatsihquin cahen jaa yoshin janan janani, jahuen jana janinhax jene bahihax huacacahinax haibo quiri bahihi. Haiboya jene tejabahti canon hihquish jascari.
Janan jananxon tiroma yoshiman potahi jene haibo quiri coshin bahihi bi nocoyamahi. Nocoti pishinai bi mai sca quehpemehtanxon jaa huaca xehaquin. Main jascajaquin yanapanah cahen haibo mahuayamahi.
Haibo qui tiroma yoshin hashoan sina sinatax haibaan baque texebo betan sca rehtenani cahi. Papan joi nincacoinaibo betan rehtenani, Jesus joi bihcoinaibo betan rehtenani cahi, jato queyocatsihqui.
Cahax, quebíjistima hian quexa sca nihreneni.
